# Tuteliq .NET SDK

> Official .NET SDK for Tuteliq, the AI-powered child safety API, for C#/.NET applications.

## What is this?
A .NET library for the Tuteliq child safety API. Detect bullying, grooming, self-harm, fraud and other harmful content in text, conversations, documents, audio, images and video; run hosted age and identity verification; manage incidents; and redact personal data. Works with ASP.NET Core, Blazor, MAUI and any .NET 8+ application.

## Install
dotnet add package Tuteliq

## Quick Start
using Tuteliq;
var client = new TuteliqClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("TUTELIQ_API_KEY")!);
var result = await client.DetectUnsafeAsync(new DetectUnsafeInput
{
    Content = "content to check",
    Context = new AnalysisContext { AgeGroup = "11-13" }
});

## Key Features
- Async/await throughout, with automatic retries and typed exceptions
- Safety detection: bullying, grooming, unsafe content, emotions, distress signals
- Fraud and extended safety: social engineering, app fraud, romance scams, mule recruitment, gambling harm, coercive control, vulnerability exploitation, radicalisation
- Media: voice, image, video and document (PDF or image) analysis, real-time voice streaming
- Verification: hosted age and identity verification sessions (CreateVerificationSessionAsync, GetVerificationSessionAsync), image verification (VerifyImageMatchAsync)
- Incidents: list, detail, overview, trends, review and batch review
- Privacy redaction (RedactAsync), webhooks, usage and quota, GDPR account tools
- Strong typing for all request and response models

## Supported Languages
32 languages: English (stable), Spanish, Portuguese, Ukrainian, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Italian, Turkish, Romanian, Greek, Czech, Hungarian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Slovak, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Slovenian, Maltese, Irish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian (beta). Auto-detected, no configuration needed.
